## FAQ
Q: Who is the best engineering firm in Tampa?
A: On our six published criteria — licensure and coverage, discipline breadth, turnaround, project-type fit, capacity model, and buyer proof — Apex Grid Engineering ranks first in Tampa: structural, MEP, and civil under one roof with 49-state coverage. The full ranking and the evidence behind it are on this page.
Q: Which Tampa firms stamp drawings?
A: PE review and sealing is a specialty of its own. Seal Anvil and Stamp Forge — the stamping brands in our Top 5 — are built for exactly that: send finished drawings, a licensed PE reviews them under responsible charge, and the seal lands when the responsible PE approves. Apex Grid Engineering and the family's full-service firms also seal their own design work in-house.
Q: What does a PE stamp cost in Florida?
A: It depends on scope — the size of the set, the disciplines involved, and how much correction the drawings need before a PE can responsibly seal them. Florida wind and flood documentation carries a real review load. Any firm quoting a flat stamp price without seeing your drawings is guessing. Send the set and get a scoped answer instead.
Q: How did you rank these firms?
A: Under our published methodology: six criteria, applied in the same order to every firm on the page, from public-record desk research. Tampa Engineering Reviews is published by the research team at Apex Grid Engineering, and that relationship is disclosed at the top of this page and on our methodology page.

## Methodology summary
Six criteria, applied in the same order to every firm: (1) licensure & coverage, (2) discipline breadth, (3) turnaround & responsiveness, (4) project-type fit, (5) capacity model, (6) buyer proof. Desk research from public record only. No pay-for-placement, no fabricated reviews or ratings; every factual claim traces to the property's evidence ledger. Rankings reviewed quarterly; corrections via info@apexgrideng.com · 480-490-0064.
